title: Add additional template variants for Follow-up, Thank You, and Complaint/Feedback emails

requirements.text: Add the user-provided Follow-up, Thank You, and Complaint/Feedback email drafts as additional template variants (not replacements) while keeping the current templates as the default output for each of these email types.
acceptanceCriteria: For email types 'follow-up', 'thank-you', and 'complaint', the existing template text remains the default draft generated when a user completes the question flow.
The new user-provided drafts are added as additional variants for their respective email types and are available to be generated without removing or overwriting the existing versions.

The new variants reflect the user-provided content structure, including the provided subject lines and placeholders (e.g., "Subject: Following Up - [Original Topic]", "Subject: Thank You - [Reason]", "Subject: Feedback Regarding [Issue]").

requirements.text: Update the 'Generate alternative' refinement behavior so that, for Follow-up, Thank You, and Complaint/Feedback email types, it can produce an alternative draft by selecting an added variant (when available) rather than regenerating the same default template.
acceptanceCriteria: When the user clicks/uses the existing 'Generate alternative' refinement for 'follow-up', 'thank-you', or 'complaint', the returned draft differs from the default template output by using one of the added variants (when variants exist).
For email types without variants, 'Generate alternative' continues to behave as it does today (no regressions).
No changes are made to the trigger keywords or email type detection behavior as part of this update.

constraints: Keep the application frontend-only; do not add persistence or template storage to the Motoko backend.
Do not change existing email type triggers in frontend/src/lib/assistant/emailTypes.ts; keep current triggers and defaults unchanged.
Do not edit any frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.frontend.immutablePaths.
nonGoals: Adding new email types beyond the existing set.
Changing the guided question flows for these email types (unless strictly necessary to support variant generation).
Adding authentication or any backend functionality for template storage.
